bio: I'm a Senior QA Engineer at Betsson in Estonia, with 10+ years across high-stakes environments — from mission-critical Brazilian Air Force systems to iGaming platforms serving thousands of stakeholders. I work the full SDLC: shaping requirements, automating browser and API tests, mentoring teams toward releases that don't need crossed fingers.
extras: ISTQB Foundation Level certified. Recently completed Full-Stack (IBM) and Web Development (University of Michigan) specialisations. Currently studying mobile testing with Appium, Android Studio, and Xcode.

entries.headline: QA & Systems Support · 2nd Lieutenant
entries.body: Started in the Brazilian Air Force. Monitoring mission-critical applications, root-cause analysis, defect management on national logistics software.

entries.headline: Data Quality Analyst · 1st Lieutenant
entries.body: Large-scale data validation and QC for national logistics data. SQL and Excel reporting to support procurement decisions.

entries.headline: QA Analyst — Captain · FGV PM Specialisation
entries.body: Test design, execution and UAT for SILOMS Aquisição (70k+ users). Defect tracking via Trello. Specialisation in Project Management from FGV.

entries.headline: Freelance Web Designer · Google UX · CS50
entries.body: Responsive web work in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React. Owned the full SDLC across projects. Google UX Design certificate; CS50 fundamentals.

entries.headline: Web Development Specialisation, U. Michigan
entries.body: Deepened front-end skills: React, validation, debugging, cross-browser testing — alongside ongoing freelance delivery.

entries.headline: Integration & QA Specialist · Yolo Group
entries.body: Validated 25+ third-party client integrations to Hub88 APIs. Postman, Elasticsearch-Kibana, JIRA. Monitored 30+ casinos and game providers.

entries.headline: QA → Senior QA · ISTQB CTFL · IBM Full-Stack
entries.body: Promoted at Hub88 to QA Engineer (Cypress → Playwright migration), then joined Betsson Estonia as Senior QA Engineer. ISTQB CTFL certified; IBM Full-Stack specialisation.
